description.narrative: The objective of the IDF grant is to improve the results orientation and effectiveness of monitoring and evaluation systems in key sectors of Zambia's Poverty Reduction Strategy Paper, the Fifth National Development Plan (FNDP). A particular goal of this project is to enhance the coordination of FNDP programs between the Ministry and lower organs to better inform the budgeting process. o Specifically, this project will assist the newly created Department of Monitoring and Evaluation in the Ministry of Finance and National Planning to strengthen its capacity and to create a viable and sustainable management information system (MIS) in key sectors that is anchored to lower structures like provinces and districts for wide-spread monitoring of the progress of development processes in line with the FNDP. o This will be done by strengthening the coordination, harmonization and alignment of existing components of the FNDP monitoring system and-for key sectors-translate them into functioning management information systems by either setting up new MIS or improving existing systems. The MiS will be set up in a way to allow tracking of budget execution linked to FNDP results monitoring. o The project will pilot these MIS and their linkage into the FNDP M&E data base in the following priority sectors: Energy, Agriculture and Transport. The objective of the IDF grant is to strengthen the capacity and results orientation of the newly created Department of Monitoring and Evaluation in the Ministry of Finance and National Planning (MoFNP) and M&E staff in the key sectors Energy, Agriculture and Transport.
